name: Prune and Apple Stuffing With Sausage and Chestnuts

instructions.primary_message: Chop the pitted prunes into 1/2-inch pieces. Cut the high-quality white sandwich bread into 1/2-inch dice. Finely chop the onions. Finely chop the celery. Chop the cooked and peeled chestnuts. Pick the sage leaves from the stems and mince them. Grate the nutmeg.
instructions.secondary_message:
170 g pitted prunes
340 g high-quality white sandwich bread
3 large onions
3 ribs celery
170 g cooked and peeled chestnuts
2 tbsp fresh sage
1 large pinch nutmeg

instructions.primary_message: In a small container, combine prunes and sherry and soak at least 2 hours, and preferably overnight.

Meanwhile, adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 135°C (275°F). Arrange bread in a single even layer on a rimmed baking sheet. Bake until completely dried, about 50 minutes total, stirring bread cubes several times during baking. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Increase oven heat to 165°C (325°F).

Meanwhile, in a large Dutch oven, melt butter or render reserved goose fat over medium heat, 2-3 minutes. Add sausage and mash with stiff whisk or potato masher to break up into fine pieces (largest pieces should be no greater than 0.5 cm thick). Cook, stirring frequently, until only a few bits of pink remain, about 4 minutes. Add onions, celery, and apples and cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in chestnuts and prunes with their soaking liquid.

In a medium bowl, whisk together chicken stock, eggs, sage, cloves, nutmeg, salt, and pepper until homogeneous. Stirring constantly with wooden spoon, slowly pour egg mixture into sausage mixture. Add bread cubes and fold gently until evenly mixed.

Use part of stuffing to stuff bird if desired (not recommended if making goose, which will yield an extremely fatty, excessively rich stuffing) or transfer to a buttered 9- by 33-cm rectangular baking dish (or 10- by 36-cm oval dish), cover tightly with aluminum foil, and bake until an instant-read thermometer registers 65°C (150°F) when inserted into center of dish, about 45 minutes. Remove foil and continue baking until golden brown and crisp on top, about 15 minutes longer. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: Christmas, goose, holiday, prune, stuffing, thanksgiving

description: This wintry stuffing, adapted from Cook's Illustrated, is studded with sweet chestnuts, savory sausage, tart apples, and sherry-soaked prunes. Nutmeg and clove deliver a touch of warming spice, livened up with the herbal aroma of chopped sage. Serve it with turkey, duck, chicken, or, our personal favorite, a crisp-skinned, flavorful roast goose.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 4 hr 10 min to 12 hr 10 min.

Optional substitutions: high-quality white sandwich bread → soft Italian bread or French bread; unsalted butter → ⅓ cup minced goose fat; homemade chicken stock → low-sodium chicken broth

Notes: If making this recipe in conjunction with our roast goose, use reserved fat in place of butter. Pat it dry and chill it before mincing.
author: Niki Achitoff-Gray
